name: Reliance Industries Limited
remarksWeb: In accordance with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, the Company had allotted bonus equity shares in dematerialised form only and bonus equity shares of shareholders holding equity shares in physical form were credited to a separate demat suspense account called RELIANCE INDUSTRIES LIMITED BONUS 2024 SUSPENSE PHY. Voting Rights under Category Public include 48 49 072 equity shares held in the Unclaimed Suspense Account, 1 86 975 equity shares held in Suspense Escrow Demat Account, 2 95 97 971 equity shares held in RELIANCE INDUSTRIES LIMITED BONUS 2024 SUSPENSE PHY and 8 64 59 278 equity shares held by Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) Authority on which voting rights are frozen. Petroleum Trust, which controlled Reliance Services and Holdings Limited, was dissolved on April 30, 2026 and name of Petroleum Trust has been removed from the shareholding pattern. As per information furnished by the Promoter and Promoter Group, there are 50 members forming part of Promoter and Promoter Group of the Company, of which 3 promoter group entities do not hold any shares. Relatives of Shri Mukesh D Ambani, Promoter and Managing Director of the Company, are disclosed under the category 'Relatives of promoters (other than immediate relatives of promoters disclosed under Promoter and Promoter Group category). The outstanding options in column No. of Shares Underlying Outstanding convertible securities (including Warrants, ESOP, etc.) under the category Foreign Nationals are held by foreign nationals being persons resident in India.
